text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow's weather is... rain, huh. Time 
for my rain boots to shine♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to the theater, shoes with a 
subdued design would be best... All right, 
it's decided!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's not in the shoe cabinet, nor in 
the case. Where could I have put it—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hong Kong! That's it! I left it behind 
when I went back home!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh, and here I felt like wearing 
that pair tomorrow. Guess I have no choice 
but to find some other shoes."

With her shoe hunt ending in vain, Satono 
Crown was left completely exhausted.
